meta.source: Read from the live site technotribes.ai on 2026-11-19 (computed styles, Tailwind classes and theme-color).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background everywhere. TechnoTribes is dark only; this is also the browser theme-color.

tokens.name: surface-maroon
tokens.usage: Warm dark panels and section washes behind red accents.

tokens.name: cta-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary pill button ("Book AI strategy call"). Text on it is red.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text on surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: supporting copy, secondary button labels. 7:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Nav links at rest. 4.3:1 on surface: below 4.5:1, so keep it to 13px+ nav items and never use it for body copy.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: The brand colour: the circuit-T logo mark and brand highlights. Use as a mark or accent, not as a text colour for long copy.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: The action colour: links, hover states, primary button text, small eyebrow labels like SCROLL. 5:1 on surface, 4.8:1 on cta-fill.

tokens.name: red-deep
tokens.usage: Thin progress and divider lines, e.g. the 1px scroll-progress bar under the header.

tokens.name: line-maroon
tokens.usage: Border of the primary pill button.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Border of secondary pill buttons and quiet dividers.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Syne (Google Fonts). Wide, heavy and tight: the voice of the brand.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: One hero headline per page (desktop size).

styles.name: h2
styles.sample: From AI experiments to working systems

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark beside the logo mark: uppercase, 0.25em tracking.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Plus Jakarta Sans (Google Fonts) for everything that is read.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase, widely tracked kicker under a hero, in ink-muted.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: TechnoTribes helps teams move from AI experiments to production workflows.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Header navigation, ink-subtle, red on hover.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Base unit (the site's spacing is on an 8px grid). Gaps inside a button or chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related items; mobile side gutter (px-5 is 20px).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Desktop side gutter (px-8) and gaps between groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between nav items and between section blocks.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Inputs, panels and images: the site is square-cornered.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons only: every button is a full pill.
